title: Better Sounds
description: Sound Studio is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you browse, preview, customize, download, and replace Minecraft sounds in real time. Open it with Right Shift.
body:
Sound Studio is a client-side Fabric mod that allows you to browse, preview, and replace any sound in Minecraft in real time.

Features:

Search all Minecraft sounds
Preview sounds instantly
Replace sounds with custom audio
Create and load sound profiles
Download any Minecraft sound
